prose.name: Relay Alignment on <Planet>
prose.briefing: The relay at the <Place> is missing its transmitter. I said I'd find one, fit it, and get the dish talking again.

beats.journal: The relay dish is fitted, but it has to align before it can lock on, and the noise has drawn attention. I need to hold until it's done.
beats.name: Relay Dish

beats.journal: I fitted the relay at the <Place> and held off three waves of attackers while it aligned. The relay is live.

broadcast: This is Relay Control. A relay on this planet has lost its transmitter. Find the replacement unit at the site, fit it to the dish, and hold the site while it aligns. Expect company.
